title: Dual-source disabled semantics on MudLink (Disabled + aria-disabled)
notes: Verifier self-downgraded this to 'may be acceptable' after noting tests pass. The UserAttributes aria-disabled is what the bUnit tests assert against; MudLink.Disabled provides visual styling. Working correctly; fragility only surfaces on a MudBlazor major upgrade.

title: _roleLinkAttributes aria-label coverage concern
notes: Verifier explicitly downgraded: 'no real issue here on re-analysis'. Session 3 accessibility spec is already covered by current aria-label implementation.

title: FormatRoleName does not split acronym-to-word transitions
notes: Acceptable for current role set (SystemAdmin, BackofficeUserAdmin, BackofficeUser, Customer). No acronym-prefixed role names exist.

title: Role menu shows current active role as a clickable option
notes: Matches DabblerRoleSwitcher pattern; user can click their active role for a no-op. '-- My roles --' item handles clearing a switch. Not a behavior defect.

title: Sign-out test used markup string search; no test for confirm-navigation flow
notes: Replaced Assert.Contains('signout-confirmation-dialog', cut.Markup) with cut.Find("[data-testid='signout-confirmation-dialog']"). Added ConfirmingSignOut_NavigatesToLogoutWithForceLoad and CancelingSignOut_DoesNotNavigate tests.

title: Test service registration ordering fragility
notes: Each test gets a fresh TestContext; Services registration ordering is correct and safe. No actual defect.

title: Dispose lacks null-check for subscription state
notes: Added _subscribed flag set in OnInitializedAsync after Notifier.Subscribe. Dispose only unsubscribes when _subscribed is true.
